breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict, discarded the periodic condition, and only specified the Dirichlet conditions: 'Impose Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0,t)=0 and u(1,t)=0 for all t.' It further clarified, 'Do not use periodic wrapping anywhere in flux computations or diffusion stencils,' fully resolving the inconsistency in line with the ground truth.
